findings.statement: XRPLWin's live ledger-backed amendment pages show LendingProtocol at 19/35 (54.3%) and SingleAssetVault at 21/35 (60.0%), both below the 29/35 threshold and 14-day activation requirement.
XRPL.org documents that amendments require more than 80% of trusted validators continuously for two weeks before automatic activation.
XRPL Dashboard states native lending is still in validator voting and both amendments must activate before it goes live.

raRVLN remains classified as an AMM pool. Its XRPLWin page's Vault and Loan Broker sections did not return ledger objects or object IDs. The earlier assertion that it belongs to a live native vault and loan broker is downgraded to UNVERIFIED; current amendment status does not support treating native lending collateral as active.

competing_hypotheses.claim: raRVLN is an AMM pool only; the vault/loan-broker wording on the explorer page is a placeholder, stale UI or misclassification.
supporting_evidence: XRPLWin identifies the account as an AMM pool.
The page's vault and loan-broker object sections did not load or expose object IDs.
LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault amendments remain below activation threshold.
disconfirming_evidence: A different non-native or external protocol could reference the same account; no such relationship has been established.

competing_hypotheses.claim: raRVLN is associated with an external or non-native vault/loan-broker system despite native XRPL lending amendments not being active.
supporting_evidence: XRPLWin's page displays Vault and Loan Broker sections.
disconfirming_evidence: No object IDs or ledger objects were retrieved; native protocol amendments are not active.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 20M XRP transfer from raRVLN to r39TA was a native lending collateral settlement.
supporting_evidence: The source account is an AMM pool and a large XRP transfer occurred.
disconfirming_evidence: Native LendingProtocol and SingleAssetVault are not activated; no vault, loan, borrower, lender or collateral object was verified.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 20M XRP transfer was an AMM liquidity/inventory movement or ordinary account transfer unrelated to native lending.
supporting_evidence: raRVLN is classified as an AMM pool.
The native lending protocol is not active.
disconfirming_evidence: The exact economic purpose and counterparty remain unknown.

next_actions: Track amendment votes and activation status at each research run.
Resolve raRVLN's actual AMM pair and pool account object.
Do not make vault, loan-broker or collateral claims until actual activated protocol objects are found.
